message.content:
Based on the search results, **Lucas Adams** currently plays Noah Newman on *The Young and the Restless*. He made his debut in the role on **November 4, 2025**.

Adams is a *Days of Our Lives* alum who previously played Tripp Dalton on that soap from 2017 to 2024, earning two Daytime Emmy nominations. Interestingly, this isn't his first appearance on *Y&R* — he had a brief one-day speaking role as "Wesley" back in 2012, which was his very first television speaking role.

He took over the role from **Rory Gibson**, who played Noah from October 2021 to April 2023 before leaving to join *General Hospital* as Michael Corinthos. Other previous adult actors to play Noah include:
- **Robert Adamson** (2012–2018, with brief returns in 2020)
- **Luke Kleintank** (2010–2011)
- **Kevin Schmidt** (2008–2010 and 2011–2012)

Noah Newman is the son of supercouple Nick Newman (Joshua Morrow) and Sharon Newman (Sharon Case), and a member of the prominent Newman family in Genoa City.
